description: Erection of a two storey side extension and single storey rear extension, replacement of the existing rear roof dormer extension, removal of a ground floor front window and repositioning of the front entrance doors and canopy, replacement of existing front and rear windows, installation of two first floor rear juliette balconies and erection of a replacement front boundary treatment.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:  077 - 141PP1.4- AL.dwg (Rev3); 007 - 150PP1.4 - AL.dwg (Proposed Front Elevation & Fence) (Rev3)  Received:  22 December 2023;  077 - 150PP1.4 - AL.dwg (Proposed Front Elevation) (Rev3)  Received:  13 December 2023;  077 - 142PP1.4 - AL.dwg (Rev3); 077 - 143PP1.4 - AL.dwg (Rev3); 077 - 144PP1.4 - AL.dwg (Rev3); 077 - 151PP1.4 - AL.dwg (Rev3); 077 - 152PP1.4 - AL.dwg (Rev3); 077 - 160PP1.4 - AL.dwg (Rev3); 077 - 161PP1.4 - AL.dwg  Received:  01 November 2023;  Unreferenced Location Plan; Unreferenced Existing Block Plan; Unreferenced Proposed Block Plan; 077 - 101PP - AL.dwg; 077 - 101PP - AL.dwg; 077- 102PP - AL.dwg; 077 - 103PP - AL.dwg; 077 - 104PP - AL.dwg; 077 - 110PP - AL.dwg; 077 - 110PP - AL.dwg; 007 - 111PP - AL.dwg; 077 - 112PP - AL.dwg; 077 - 120PP - AL.dwg; 077 - 121PP - AL.dwg; 077 - 141FSP - AL.dwg; 077 - 141FSP - AL.dwg; 077 - 141FSP - AL.dwg  Received:  11 August 2023.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the two storey side extension, single storey rear extension and extended rear roof dormer extension hereby approved.
Condition : 5 - The proposed replacement front vehicular and pedestrian gates shall be designed and installed to not open into the public footway and be permanently maintained as such.
